passages.provision_quote: It is the intent of the Legislature that all state agencies aim to achieve net-zero emissions of greenhouse gases resulting from their operations, including scope 1 and scope 2 emissions, no later than January 1, 2035, or as soon as feasible thereafter.
passages.note: A net-zero emissions target for state agency operations names no energy source and can be met by means other than a clean-energy mandate (H17).

rows.reasoning: SB 1203 (2021-2022), authored by Becker, declares legislative intent that state agencies 'achieve net-zero emissions of greenhouse gases resulting from their operations ... no later than January 1, 2035' and requires inventories, plans, and reports toward that goal. Per H17, an emissions-reduction goal that names no energy source can be met by means other than 'a shift to clean energy,' so this establishes only the pro-action side, not rung 1's clean-energy-mandate clause or any other rung's clause.
